scope: fixing commits 9d5638b and 29a9f8e for the zig-test timeout cause
summary:
I approve the two fixing commits. They fix the recorded cause, and they remove, skip, exclude, or weaken no test, gate, timeout, or threshold. This verdict covers the fix only. FP-0098 as a task still has review 2's open item: the CI record of compile and run phase durations.

**They fix the recorded cause.**
- The ledger's [INFERENCE] cause is FP-0014 case 46's 100000-element chain. Before the fix, each append's pre-insert check walked from the parent to the root, about 5 × 10⁹ parent lookups in total.
- Every failed Zig head has the same pre-fix `src/dom.zig` blob `37667a5` and CSS test blob `96068291` (`engineering/evidence/ci/timeout-source-identity-attempt-2.log`).
- `9d5638b` changes `isInclusiveAncestor` to return true for the same node, return false for a node without children, and otherwise run the unchanged walk, now named `isInclusiveAncestorByWalk` (`fix-history.log`, dom.zig hunk at 751).
- The shortcut is correct for every tree shape. Only `link` sets a parent pointer, and it always sets the parent's `first_child` (src/dom.zig:691-701). `remove` clears `first_child` only when the last child leaves (src/dom.zig:709-723). So any node with a descendant has a non-null `first_child`.
- The new test compares the shortcut with the walk on all 144 ordered pairs of 12 nodes and checks the count of 29 related pairs.
- Locally, the chain part fell from 177806.055 ms to 2164.506 ms (`FP-0098/raw/probe-case46-parts*.log`), and case 46 fell from 167071.659 ms to 2786.094 ms (`test-profile-before.log`, `test-profile-after.log`).
- On CI, the ten dispatched runs of `29a9f8e` all pass, with the slowest `zig-test` step at 191 s on Windows and 188 s on Linux (`FP-0098/ci/dispatched-runs.log`).

**They weaken nothing.**
- In the src, tests, and build.zig paths, the recorded diffs show `9d5638b` adding 55 lines to `src/dom.zig` and deleting none. `src/css/tests.zig` keeps blob `96068291`, so case 46 keeps its depth of 100000 and its assertions.
- The test-name comparison shows 292 tests before and 293 after, with none missing and one added.
- Each recorded range diff over `engineering/gates.json`, `.github/workflows`, `toolchains`, `tools/lib.mjs`, and `build.zig` shows only `tools/lib.mjs` changing among those paths, in `9d5638b`. The exception is `a3e5cf9..29a9f8e`, which also has `152ed53`'s six-line Linux workflow addition (`ranges/*.log`, fix-history.log:439-441 and 2062-2069).
- The `tools/selftest.mjs` hunk of `9d5638b` only adds lines: cases FP-0098 1 to 3 and their helpers.
- The runner change cannot turn a timeout into a pass. `timedOut = true` is set at the unchanged deadline, before the listing. The command ending during the listing returns early with `timed_out: true`. `runGate` still requires exit code 0, no signal, no timeout, and no error. The listing can only delay the stop, by up to 10 s.
- The kill commands are only moved into `stopProcessTree`, unchanged. The bare `taskkill.exe` name is the base's existing behavior, not a change.
- `tools/zig/test_profile_runner.zig` is not part of `build.zig` or any gate.
- `29a9f8e` changes evidence only within the recorded paths. It does not appear in the path logs over `src`, `tests`, `build.zig`, `tools/lib.mjs`, gates, workflows, or toolchains.

findings.issue: The record shows `9d5638b` only through path-limited commands (`git show 9d5638b -- tools/lib.mjs src/dom.zig tools/selftest.mjs`) and `29a9f8e` only through its README diff. No full `--name-status` of either commit is recorded. So a change to a controller test file outside `src`, `tests`, `tools/lib.mjs`, and `tools/selftest.mjs` would not appear, for example `tools/workflow-check.test.mjs` or `tools/attest.test.mjs`. [INFERENCE] There was none: the worker's `git status --short` in `FP-0098/raw/tests-after.log:126-142` lists only `src/dom.zig`, `tools/README.md`, `tools/lib.mjs`, `tools/selftest.mjs`, and `tools/zig/` outside evidence, and the commit message of `29a9f8e` describes an evidence-only change.
findings.recommendation: Record `git show --name-status --format=%H 9d5638b 29a9f8e` in the ledger so the no-weakening condition rests on the complete file list of both commits.

findings.issue: The cause of each of the nine replacement failures stays [INFERENCE], because no failed run kept build output or a process listing. The rule allows that. This approval also does not satisfy the other open ledger conditions: every run in each task window must conclude, including the four that were in progress at the snapshot. For the review-record condition, this approval counts only if it is stored as a `fairpane-review` record in `engineering/evidence` before the affected acceptances.
findings.recommendation: Store this verdict as a review record in `engineering/evidence` before any affected acceptance. Record the four unconcluded runs, and any later pushed heads, before you rely on the replacement.
